headline: Microsoft says China's Salt Typhoon and North Korean crews now run attacks through ARTEX, as Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI intrusions.

emerging_trends.text: Microsoft, GreyNoise, and the Swiss and Italian cyber agencies all tied this week's intrusions to ARTEX and autonomous agents, pushing AI tooling into routine state tradecraft.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Researchers Map Agentic AI Attack Tradecraft

emerging_trends.text: Attackers increasingly seize one trusted developer account, as the 1Password GitHub compromise and the backdoored WP Connect plugins both show.

topics.title: Researchers Map Agentic AI Attack Tradecraft
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft said China's Salt Typhoon, Crystal Typhoon, Storm-0940, Storm-3358, and North Korea's Onyx Sleet and Pearl Sleet now use the ARTEX framework for reconnaissance and credential attacks.
topics.why_it_matters: State crews fold a public AI penetration-testing tool into existing playbooks, which speeds reconnaissance and web application exploitation against every internet-facing asset you run.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: GreyNoise tracks a separate AI-driven campaign as GT13, counting 24 compromised Check Point management servers at 22 organizations in financial services, energy, and government.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: The Swiss and Italian national cyber agencies warned that AI agents now run automated attacks on critical infrastructure operators.

topics.title: Hackers Exploit Drupal Flaw Found by Anthropic
topics.latest_developments: Drupal confirmed attackers have exploited CVE-2026-132165, dubbed Fail2Install and rated 9.8, since at least November 19, and CISA set a November 27 patch deadline.
topics.why_it_matters: Unpatched Drupal sites face full takeover, and an Anthropic AI scanner found the bug, so AI-discovered flaws now reach attackers fast.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: CISA added two more exploited bugs: CVE-2026-132224 in Optimizely Web Experimentation, used to plant malicious JavaScript on major websites, and CVE-2026-131914 in the Idunno AntiCsrf library.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Update Drupal core immediately. Rip Idunno AntiCsrf out of legacy ASP.NET applications, because the project is defunct and a single crafted web request runs code.

sources.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites

topics.title: FinCEN Pulls Systems Offline After Intrusion
topics.latest_developments: The Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network took systems offline after a cyberattack that gained unauthorized access to a limited subset of them.
topics.why_it_matters: FinCEN holds suspicious activity reports from every United States bank, so an intruder inside it sees which people and companies investigators are tracking.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Attackers also breached an open-source intelligence analysis system at the Central Intelligence Agency, adding detail to Monday's report of an unclassified system compromise.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Colorado said criminals likely stole data on 150,000 myColorado users and knocked the state's digital identification app offline.

details.label: What's next
details.text: FinCEN extended filing deadlines for institutions the outage hit while its investigation runs.

topics.title: Attackers Run Commands on Hex.pm Servers
topics.latest_developments: An attacker exploited a flaw rated 10.0 on Monday to run operating system commands on six production servers of Hex.pm, the Elixir and Erlang package registry.
topics.why_it_matters: Control of a registry lets one attacker poison dependencies for every Elixir and Erlang project that fetches packages from it.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The bug had sat in the registry's code since February 2016. Maintainers moved every server to a patched build within about 15 minutes of the first malicious request.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Check WordPress installations for six WP Connect plugins backdoored on November 22, 2026 after a suspected developer account compromise. WordPress blocked the releases before publication.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Researchers found 13 malicious NuGet packages pushed through fake recruitment assessments aimed at .NET developers, which hand attackers access to developer machines.

sources.title: Hackers Exploited CVSS 10.0 Hex.pm RCE Flaw to Compromise 6 Package Registry Servers

topics.title: Iran Sabotages Freezers as Danfoss Flaw Sits Unpatched

details.label: What to do

topics.title: Palo Alto Patches Firewall-Rooting Fragnesia Flaw
topics.latest_developments: Palo Alto Networks patched Fragnesia after a China-linked group chained it with PHP2Shell in AI-assisted attacks that took root on 25 servers.
topics.why_it_matters: Firewalls see all traffic crossing the network edge, so root access hands an espionage group a trusted vantage point inside victim networks.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The chained exploits hit PAN-OS devices whose management interfaces face the internet.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Apply the Palo Alto Networks fix on internet-facing firewalls, then hunt for PHP2Shell artifacts and unexplained root processes on the appliances.

topics.title: Attackers Exploit Two Patched GeoServer Flaws
topics.latest_developments: watchTowr reported active exploitation of two newly patched GeoServer flaws, CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243, which researchers chain into unauthenticated remote code execution.
topics.why_it_matters: The chain needs no credentials, so any internet-facing GeoServer instance can fall to full server compromise.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: CVE-2026-120705, rated 8.6, lets an attacker read local text files the GeoServer process can reach.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Install the patched GeoServer releases now and review web logs for file read attempts against the server.

events.latest_developments: TribLive published a guide Wednesday, November 25, to holiday concerts, musicals, and stage shows playing in Pittsburgh and Western Pennsylvania this season.
events.why_it_matters: Readers get one list to plan December performances around, alongside light tours and ice skating.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: TribLive's reviewer called "Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas The Musical" a high note to start the holidays.

around_teams.title: Steelers Release Rodgers After Benching Fallout
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers released Aaron Rodgers Wednesday, November 25, hours after he attacked head coach Mike McCarthy publicly, and McCarthy said the benching followed an ultimatum.
around_teams.why_it_matters: Pittsburgh hands its season to Mason Rudolph and walks into Friday's Denver game with its head coach's authority in question.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: McCarthy told reporters he keeps the locker room's support and called the moment he led a "Packers" cheer in Pittsburgh's locker room embarrassing.

details.label: What's next
details.text: The Steelers host the Denver Broncos Friday, November 27, at 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.

sources.title: Coach Mike McCarthy Press Conference (November 25) | Pittsburgh Steelers

around_teams.title: Rudolph Meets Media as Steelers Starter
around_teams.latest_developments: Mason Rudolph spoke with reporters Wednesday, November 25, as the Steelers' starting quarterback for the Black Friday game against the Denver Broncos.
around_teams.why_it_matters: Rudolph takes the offense for the rest of a season Pittsburgh started with Aaron Rodgers under center.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler worked through the Steelers news and gave their final Denver predictions on Wednesday's SNR Drive, with sideline reporter Missi Matthews calling in.

sources.title: Mason Rudolph Press Conference (November 25) | Pittsburgh Steelers
Steelers Vs Broncos Predictions | SNR Drive (Nov.25) | Pittsburgh Steelers

around_teams.title: Farrior Joins Heyward for Thanksgiving Episode
around_teams.latest_developments: Two-time Super Bowl champion and former Steelers captain James Farrior joined Cam Heyward and Hayden Walsh on Not Just Football's Thanksgiving episode Wednesday, November 25.
around_teams.why_it_matters: Heyward's show pairs a former captain's account of the Browns brawl and playing for Mike Tomlin with a preview of Friday's game.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Heyward and Walsh gave away a pair of Heyward's game-worn cleats, debated whether turkey is overrated, and picked their Steelers Thanksgiving guest list.

sources.source: Not Just Football with Cam Heyward
sources.title: James Farrior On The Browns Brawl, Two Super Bowls, Mike Tomlin, & More! | Not Just Football

around_teams.title: SNR Drive Starts Its Broncos Breakdown
around_teams.latest_developments: Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler opened their Denver Broncos breakdown on SNR Drive Tuesday, November 24, picking a Broncos player to watch and working through Week 12 power rankings.
around_teams.why_it_matters: The short Thanksgiving week compresses preparation, and the show offers the first detailed look at Denver's personnel before Friday.

details.label: What's next
details.text: Williamson previewed his Week 12 statistics packet on the show.

sources.title: Beginning To Preview The Denver Broncos | SNR Drive (Nov.24) | Pittsburgh Steelers

team_usa.title: ESPN Charts Growth Before 2031 U.S. Cup
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN published an analysis Wednesday, November 25, charting women's soccer's growth since the 1999 tournament as FIFA sends the 2031 Women's World Cup back to the United States.
team_usa.why_it_matters: United States host cities and U.S. Soccer get a second home Women's World Cup, with the tournament's finances now turning positive.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: FIFA chief football officer Jill Ellis said the 2027 Women's World Cup will be the first edition of the tournament to turn a profit.

sources.title: Women's World Cup returning to U.S. shows how the game has grown
FIFA's Jill Ellis: '27 Women's World Cup will be first to turn a profit

team_usa.title: Shoulder Injury Sidelines Trinity Rodman
team_usa.latest_developments: A shoulder injury Trinity Rodman suffered in the National Women's Soccer League Championship will keep her out of the United States' Concacaf W Championship, ESPN reported Wednesday, November 25.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Head coach Emma Hayes loses her most dangerous attacker for the tournament that decides qualification for the 2027 Women's World Cup.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Rodman played through the Washington Spirit's third consecutive championship defeat before the injury surfaced.

sources.title: Trinity Rodman ruled out of Women's World Cup qualifier with shoulder injury

team_usa.title: Copa América's U.S. Return Draws Criticism
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN argued Tuesday, November 24, that staging the 2028 Copa América in the United States helps the men's national team and strips South America of its own tournament.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The United States men's team gets a third continental tournament on home soil in 12 years, with familiar venues and crowds before the next World Cup cycle.

sources.title: Another U.S.-held Copa América is great for USMNT but not South America
